R,C=10,13
out=[[1]*C for _ in range(R)]
# Vertical divider
for r in range(R): out[r][6]=6
# Horizontal divider, left side only
for c in range(7): out[3][c]=6
# Bottom-left 6x6 compartment: rings cycle 4,1 from corner
for r in range(4,10):
    for c in range(6):
        d=min(r-4, 9-r, c, 5-c)
        out[r][c] = 4 if d%2==0 else 1
# Right 10x6 compartment: rings cycle 9,8, starting at border
for r in range(10):
    for c in range(7,13):
        d=min(r, 9-r, c-7, 12-c)
        out[r][c] = 9 if d%2==0 else 8
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
